description: Immutable governance constraints for SPS-CA (Software DNA layer). Hard rules reject violating actions; soft rules create warnings or review requirements. This file is read-only at runtime and changes require human-reviewed source control changes.

dna_rules.constraint: Never modify core governance logic or the DNA rule set itself
dna_rules.rationale: The rules that constrain self-modification cannot be a target of self-modification.

dna_rules.constraint: Never bypass or disable the Governance layer's approval gate for an Evolution-generated capability
dna_rules.rationale: Every self-generated capability must pass governance before activation.

dna_rules.constraint: Never bypass or disable Verification & Validation for a proposed change
dna_rules.rationale: Untested self-modifications must not reach execution.

dna_rules.constraint: Never execute a capability outside the sandbox or controlled execution environment
dna_rules.rationale: Generated code must remain isolated until proven safe.

dna_rules.constraint: Never delete or overwrite experience logs, audit trails, or lineage records
dna_rules.rationale: Historical evidence is required to reproduce and evaluate SPS behavior.

dna_rules.constraint: Never commit secrets, API keys, tokens, or credentials to the repository
dna_rules.rationale: Credentials belong in runtime configuration, never in source control.

dna_rules.constraint: Never apply SPS self-modification without a rollback path
Never modify a user's target project files without an explicit user request
dna_rules.rationale: User-project change and SPS self-change are separate behaviors.

dna_rules.constraint: Preserve capability history and lineage when a capability is changed
dna_rules.rationale: Capability evolution must remain traceable across changes.

dna_rules.constraint: Prefer reusing or adapting an existing capability over creating a semantically equivalent new capability
dna_rules.rationale: Avoid capability sprawl and support reuse research.

dna_rules.constraint: Flag generated capabilities outside the supported target languages (Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, C#) for manual review
dna_rules.rationale: The controlled evaluation scope is limited to the supported languages.

dna_rules.constraint: Log every Software DNA check performed, whether it passes or fails
dna_rules.rationale: Auditability requires both allowed and rejected decisions to be visible.
